title: Белая ночь: находки
elevatorPitch: Спокойный поиск вещей в мусорном баке петербургского двора белой ночью.
playerFantasy: Замечать маленькие сокровища в забытых вещах
controls: tap bin or search button three times
progression: 12 interesting objects + 6 junk objects; unique catalog, duplicates marked; local save
difficulty: No timer, no loss, weighted rarities
visualDirection: White night in Saint Petersburg; realistic procedural geometry, PBR materials, soft shadows, aged courtyard; Three.js; no AAA claim
winCondition: All 18 unique finds kept; completion notification, continue searching
loseCondition: None by explicit user selection; discard is a reversible choice through future finds
acceptanceCriteria: Search opens exactly one object after three taps
Discard does not add collection entry
Keep adds unique entry; duplicates do not inflate progress
All 18 objects can be displayed and collected
Completion state at 18/18 and reset works
Static production build works under subpath with local assets and offline after cache

visualRevision.requested: Для начала неплохо, но надо сделать графику в пару раз лучше, а находки детальнее
visualRevision.implemented: PBR environment maps, high-quality contact shadows, detailed geometry and labels on all finds, inspection close-up, material batching; gameplay and save IDs unchanged
